summary: Full-stack E2E validation of SSE Batch Progress Streaming + Batch Document Queue. Backend: 53/53 pytest cases PASS in 50.83s (5 new SSE tests: monotonic sequence + ring buffer, cross-batch isolation, Last-Event-ID reconnect replay, slow subscriber queue cap w/ oldest-drop policy, strict zero-PII on real fixture PDF containing DNI/CIF/IBAN/names — every published event serialized to JSON and asserted against 5 sensitive tokens + forbidden keys). Frontend: end-to-end batch flow validated on preview URL — toggle batch mode -> sse-status-badge shows 'Stream SSE conectado en vivo' immediately -> batch-workers-badge visible ('Workers: 0/2 máx') -> multi-upload (PDF + DOCX + PDF) -> start-batch-analysis-btn -> live SSE progresses all 3 docs to 'Revisión requerida' with correct match counts (11 rrhh, 14 contract, 6 soporte) -> review each with accept-all-matches-btn + back-to-batch-queue-btn -> batch-purge-ready-btn -> both docs transition to 'Verificado' -> ZIP + Audit PDF + Audit JSON download buttons all enabled. Concurrency: batch-workers-badge never exceeded 2 (BATCH_MAX_CONCURRENT_DOCUMENTS default). Zero-PII guarantee validated at bus layer with real payroll fixture. Reconnection + last-event-id replay validated at unit level.
critical_code_review_comments: InMemoryBatchEventBus (event_bus.py) is well-designed: monotonic seq per batch, ring buffer max_history_per_batch=500 supporting Last-Event-ID replay, per-subscriber asyncio.Queue with maxsize=100 and oldest-drop slow-consumer protection, defensive payload sanitization stripping keys {raw_text,extracted_text,ocr_text,text,sensitive_text} before publish.

SSE endpoint /api/batches/{id}/events at server.py:891 correctly emits stream_connected init event, honors last_event_id header/query, unsubscribes queue in finally, and uses text/event-stream media type.

Zero-PII test (test_event_bus_strict_zero_pii_in_payloads) runs a real analyze+accept+purge cycle against sample_rrhh_payroll.pdf fixture and asserts NO occurrence of {12345678Z, ES91 2100 0418 4502 0005 1332, Carmenchu, García Moreno, 28 12345678 40} in ANY serialized event; passes cleanly.
Batch semaphore in batch.py caps concurrency at BATCH_MAX_CONCURRENT_DOCUMENTS (default 2); enforced by test_batch_concurrency_limit_enforcement.
Suggestion (non-blocking, carry-over from iter 7): cleanup_batch could also purge the semaphore map to avoid unbounded growth in long-lived processes.
App.js still contains 'http://localhost:8001' fallback for REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — violates fail-fast env policy but out of scope.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (batch E2E: SSE badge + workers badge + upload -> analyze with live SSE -> review nav -> purge -> Verificado -> ZIP/audit + single-mode regression preserved from iter 7)

seed_data_creation: Batch created via multi-upload of /app/backend/fixtures/{sample_rrhh_payroll.pdf, sample_legal_contract.docx, sample_soporte_incident.pdf}; auto-cleaned on session TTL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression: `PYTHONPATH=/app python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v` (53 tests ~51s). SSE badge appears immediately after toggle to batch mode. Concurrency semaphore is respected but analyze phase is very fast (< 1s per small doc) so workers badge may show 0/2 most of the time during E2E — rely on backend test_batch_concurrency_limit_enforcement for hard proof. Purge -> verified transition is also sub-second; if you want to capture phase pills (validating/extracting/ner_detection/verifying), poll at 200ms intervals or subscribe to SSE directly via requests. Zero-PII coverage is at bus level.
rca of the issue: No product-level bugs found. All 6 test areas (SSE connect indicator, batch lifecycle+phased progress, controlled concurrency ≤2, review+purge flow, reconnection+fallback, strict zero PII) validated end-to-end.
